title: Add Goals Resource and Update Agents Md
description: Verify mcp goals resource exists and lists all goals; adjust AGENTS.md so agents must list goals before starting a ticket.
summary: Added repo CLI `goal list` and `goal tree` subcommands streaming via StreamGoals and rendering the monorepo goal tree. Strengthened TestGoalList to assert returned []*Goal is non-empty and well-formed, fixed TestGoalListIDs (had wrong type assertion []Goal and wrong expected ID shape — now expects fully prefixed hierarchical id), and added TestGoalListCommand and TestGoalTreeCommand exercising the cobra root. AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md updated to require listing goals via `repo://goals` before opening a ticket. Verified all TestGoal* tests pass.
